limitations: Ideal rigid Newtonian laminar tube does not resolve real capillary cell mechanics or pulsatility.
Classical source values are arithmetic-consistent; fixed pressures do not establish general in-vivo exchange.
Revised interface account does not predict human flux kinetics from fixed oncotic pressures.
Regional constant-rate accounting is a finite short-interval teaching construction; no tissue compliance or variable drainage.
Autoregulation time constant, pressure ratios and resistance bounds are synthetic; no clinical thresholds.
Sampled source visual audit is bounded; clinical terms do not form a diagnostic or treatment algorithm.
Human histology represents partial regional walls from postmortem organ donors with mixed hypertension/diabetes, not a normal universal wall-thickness ratio.
Arterial source field has no separately resolved printed I; no new intima leader supplied.
Mouse baseline lanthanum TEM is preparation-dependent, not a living hydrated glycocalyx geometry or full fluid-exchange mechanism.
Fenestrated/sinusoidal capillaries, pericyte/junction detail, lymphatic routes and remaining model/anatomical coverage are not completed by the new microscopy.
